name: @aise/world-reality-substrate
description: AISE world program substrate-neutral Reality-layer runtime contracts (WORLD-P0-A): typed adapter ports for the five open-source substrates the 2026-10-02 product directive integrates under the canonical core — Babylon.js (interactive scene runtime), CesiumJS (geospatial context), OpenUSD (composition semantics), glTF/GLB (runtime asset delivery) and Assimp (format ingest). Contracts receive AISE scene-composition/domain types and return opaque handles; substrate types NEVER cross the port; every substrate is replaceable behind its contract (substitution doubles + property tests prove implementability WITHOUT the substrate — the technology-substitution-contract three laws). glTF parsing/validation is REAL and fully runnable headless (JSON chunk + GLB container, fail-closed); GPU-dependent behavior is declared BLOCKED with the WORLD-P1 measurement protocol. No new runtime dependencies; no substrate is imported.
